references.text: The description of the table of showbread that was to be placed outside the veil, as mentioned in this verse.
The description of the lampstand (menorah) that was to be placed opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle.
The description of the veil (parokhet) that separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
The fulfillment of this command when Moses set up the table and the lampstand in the tabernacle.
Instructions regarding the showbread that was to be placed on the table in the Holy Place.
Instructions concerning the placement of the lampstand and how the lamps were to shine forward.
Solomon's temple had golden tables and lampstands arranged in a similar manner in the Holy Place.
Description of the tables and lampstands in Solomon's temple, which followed the pattern from the tabernacle.
The first tent had the lampstand and the table with the showbread, confirming the arrangement described in Exodus 2.
The instruction regarding placement in 26:35 is specified and completed at the dedication in 40:4.
Confirms that the actual positioning of the lampstand on the south side followed the instruction in 26:35.
Confirms that the table's placement on the north side followed the instruction in 26:35.
